Vicar of Rownhams

He married (6 May 1847) Maria Trench (1820/1-7 Dec 1908).

He was educated at Oriel College, Oxford, and served as curate of Hursley, then curate of Ampfield from April 1841; he resigned Ampfield in October 1853; he was perpetual curate of Baldersby Yorks 1858-63, and vicar of Rownhams 1863; he left issue [PB 1914 Ashtown; Clergy List]
